newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder, TCI complete cable sale.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder, TCI complete cable sale.

text.p: Knight-Ridder Inc and Tele- Communications Inc said on Friday they closed the previously announced sale of Knight-Ridder's interest in all but one of their jointly owned cable investments.

Knight-Ridder said it expected to report an after-tax gain on the transaction of between $130 and $150 million in the first quarter. The company said it expected the total sale to yield net after-tax proceeds between $270 and $300 million.
Payment for the systems is a combination of cash and stock, it said.
Knight-Ridder said it would use proceeds to reduce debt levels and fund its share repurchase activity.
